status_summary: CLEARED TO DOWNLOAD AND SUBMIT with two disclosed caveats: the lane's preregistered strike-agreement test failed, and the literal >70% 3-pixel uniqueness rule is breached only by reference rasters whose coverage makes that statistic uninformative (excess over chance <= 0). Format, leakage, holdout-vs-random, surface-uniqueness and chance-adjusted dot-uniqueness gates all pass. No organizer receipt exists; no slot used.

valid_holdout_dti.ci_method: percentile bootstrap of 3182 spatial blocks of 40x40 px over the pooled additive DTI contribution maps
valid_holdout_dti.limitation: The holdout truth is the PUBLIC catalogue (60,988 px), a proxy for - not a copy of - the private new-fault test set. Its size is ~3-4x the test set implied by the registry calibration, so the holdout-optimal dot count is biased high and the dot count was chosen from the registry calibration instead. Absolute holdout DTI is not a leaderboard prediction.

strike_test.test: withheld fault segments agree in strike with the tensor field more often than random detected ridges do

validator_findings.checks_passed: 11 of 11 (single band, float32, EPSG:32611, 3730x3292, geotransform, 100 m, NaN exactly outside the template footprint, finite inside, values in [0,1], positives exist, no positive on a mapped catalogue pixel)
validator_findings.note: Local validation against the authentic organiser template; NOT an organiser portal validation or a score receipt.

experiments: E2 dot-count / separation / dilation morphology sweep with a random control at every morphology
E3 preregistered final run with spatial-block bootstrap CI, ablation and the strike test
